note: Four High paths were judged overstated: the toolchain and cache actions reach a runner whose token scope is not established (no readable run log, and `peter-evans/create-pull-request` would need a write token the workflow never declares), Medium at most; the unprotected `main` gives a writer a runner with no secret, Low; `curl https://clickhouse.com/cli | sh` is the organisation's own installer, Low (the spec's insider ceiling would hold it at Medium, the same open question as the other first-party installers).

ceilings.pending: a path whose only reach is a push step under a default token whose scope could not be read stays proven at High, where the unknown token should leave it unverified one tier down.
